meta.name: pro-workflow
meta.description: Complete AI coding workflow system. Orchestration patterns, 18 hook events, 5 agents, cross-agent support, reference guides, and searchable learnings. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and 32+ agents.

copy.tagline: 编排多智能体协作完成编码工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个AI编码助手协同完成复杂开发任务。
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multi-agent collaboration for coding workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage multiple AI coding assistants working together on complex development tasks.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会遵循一套编码工作流程：出错时主动提出改进规则，编码前先确认假设，任务结束时自动总结，并支持并行工作、分阶段开发等模式。
howto.when: 当你纠正 Claude 的错误、要求“记住这个”或“别再那样做”时触发自我修正；当你开始新功能或遇到阻塞时，可启动并行工作树。

say.text: 把这条加到你的规则里。
say.note: 触发自我修正协议，Claude 会提出一条新规则。

say.text: 帮我规划这个多文件功能。
say.note: 启动规划代理，分解任务并等待批准。
运行结束仪式，审计变更、捕获学习点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows a structured coding workflow: proactively proposes rules when corrected, confirms assumptions before coding, summarizes at session end, and supports parallel worktrees and phased development.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you correct Claude, say 'Add that to your rules' or 'Remember this'; also when starting a new feature or blocked by long operations.

say_en.note: Triggers self-correction protocol; Claude proposes a new rule.

say_en.text: Plan this multi-file feature for me.
say_en.note: Starts planner agent to break down tasks and wait for approval.
Executes session end ritual: audit changes, capture learnings.
